custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the bone. Real fossils have specific crack patterns and pore structures. AI often generates 'noisy' or 'muddy' textures on large flat surfaces like the frill. Verify if the cracks look physically plausible or randomly generated. Also, check the background geometry for warping.
